briefdescription.para: balanceTree - Used by add_internal and remove_internal to balance a newly created tree.
add_internal - Creates a new tree that includes the specified data and the data from the original tree.

detaileddescription.para: If the original tree already contained the data item, the original tree is returned.

briefdescription.para: remove_internal - Creates a new tree that includes all the data from the original tree except the specified data.

detaileddescription.para: If the specified data did not exist in the original tree, the original tree is returned.

briefdescription.para: markImmutable - Clears the mutable bits of a root and all of its descendants.
